info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fixed Asset Register Validation API
info.description: The Fixed Asset Register Validation API is designed to facilitate the validation of asset records within the enterprise's fixed asset register. This endpoint allows users to submit specific parameters for checking the accuracy and completeness of asset data, ensuring compliance and proper financial reporting. Typical consumers include finance teams, asset managers, and auditors who require reliable tools for asset verification. By integrating this API, organizations can streamline their asset management processes and enhance data integrity.

post.summary: Validate a fixed asset register entry.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to validate a specific entry in the fixed asset register identified by RES-100045. Ensure the data adheres to required business rules for proper asset management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate the fixed asset register entry for the specified asset ID (RES-100045). It contains the necessary information and parameters required for the validation process, ensuring that all data meets the expected criteria before proceeding with any further operations.
